title: Personal Branding
subtitle: My Khmer name, ម៉ាត់រ៉ភីយ៉ះ, drawn as a personal seal.
teaser: A small family of marks built from my name in Khmer, shown at their proper sizes with the palette and the rules that keep them consistent.

name.khmer: ម៉ាត់រ៉ភីយ៉ះ

story: ម៉ាត់រ៉ភីយ៉ះ is my name written in Khmer. This personal identity presents the lettering as a seal, with variations for my portfolio, navigation, and profile images. A simple palette of ink, paper, and vermilion connects the designs.

marks.name: Open seal
marks.description: The lettering without a surrounding shape.

marks.name: Rounded seal
marks.description: The lettering set against a filled rounded square.
marks.use: For square profile images; the vermilion version is the browser icon.

marks.name: Framed seal
marks.description: The lettering enclosed by a separate frame.

marks.name: Circle
marks.description: The lettering arranged within a filled circle.

navMarks.name: Compact signature
navMarks.description: The seal beside my name in Khmer and English, separated by a vertical line.

navMarks.name: Navigation seal
navMarks.description: A compact version of the seal, used as a home link when space is limited.

palette.name: Ink
palette.use: For lettering and marks on light backgrounds.

palette.name: Vermilion
palette.use: The seal's red accent, including the favicon background.

palette.name: Paper
palette.use: A warm off-white for light backgrounds and reversed lettering on dark backgrounds.

usage: One flat colour per mark: ink on light, paper on dark, or vermilion on paper. Never vermilion on ink.
Show the whole mark. Never crop, stretch, rotate, or recolour a part of it.
Give it room, with clear space of at least one eighth of its size on every side.
Keep to the minimum sizes. Below them, the Khmer diacritics stop resolving.
